test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"availability".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"availability"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• We use the word **"availability**" to refer to the state of being **accessible **or **attainable**.
 
 
• **Example:** The availability of oxygen, The availability of food to the poor etc.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 1)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

__
 
• **Shortage:** A situation where there is not enough of something.

 
 
• **Example:** While accepting the **shortage** of petrol, the authorities advised against panic buying.
 
 
 
• **Lack: **To be deficient or missing.
 
 
• **Example:** Many students** lack** concentration power when they study.
 
 

**Note:**__** "Shortage"** usually indicates something physical, whereas "**lack**" often refers to something immaterial (e.g. Lack of wisdom, lack of courage etc.).
